identity.title: [v0.91.8][WP-09][provider] Add Kimi and current agentic model providers

values.goal: Make current frontier and cost-efficient agentic models selectable through typed ADL provider contracts without collapsing distinct vendors into one ambiguous compatible endpoint.
values.required_outcome: ADL v2 and Runtime v3 can later configure, validate, invoke, observe, and truthfully classify selected provider/model lanes through stable provider identities, bounded credential contracts, capability truth, model snapshots, normalized errors, and deterministic fixtures.
declared_scope: Provider identity and model-profile expansion for Kimi, MiniMax, hosted Qwen, xAI, Mistral, Cohere, DeepSeek, Z.ai, Gemini, OpenAI, and Anthropic
Shared transport reuse only where vendor contracts are truthfully compatible
Deterministic provider fixtures, model-resolution snapshots, and redaction checks
Bounded optional live-smoke plan for operator-supplied credentials
authority_boundary: No product implementation, provider calls, credentials, AWS, raw gh, GitHub mutation, PR publication, or root-main writes
Execution is gated by live WP-09 #5349 merge plus ancestry on current origin/main
Closeout receipts are non-blocking audit evidence and never execution authority
Model scores or provider output cannot grant review, merge, conductor, janitor, or closeout authority
operator_constraints: Use typed C-SDLC v2 only for issue state
No raw gh, AWS, credentials, provider calls, PR publication, or root-main writes
One exact pre-PR review after implementation; no preparation review churn
Live WP-09 merge and ancestry gate execution; receipts are audit evidence only
